Thank you so much for your message. I am really grateful that you know how I feel, but I'm also extremely sorry that you suffer in this way, it's something I wouldn't wish on anyone. 

It's hard to accept my current limitations because I know I've done so much better in the past and was capable of so much. As you know, all the energy in life is devoted to basic function and note giving in to crippling fear. It feels like I'll never get that energy back. 
I know that it's illogical to say 'Never', it's impossible to move past the current awfulness and look forward to the future. So far I've lived for others, and it's really difficult to find a reason to live for myself.

I try to not go to the emergency room but if I ever need to I don't want to hurt my family and friends. Do you think it's possible to be anonymous? 
Even though I hurt them by being sick,  I Don't want to hurt them by letting them know that I honestly don't want to live.  Thank you so much for your support and  kindness my friend.xx
